messages.author: 48ecc1e3de37e653
messages.subject: Re: Error in part 5? "number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 3)"
parts: Through some debugging I can tell that some of the output objects in the .RData files in the meta data in the ms5.out folder has 122 columns (with some number of rows) while for some files the output object has 500 columns and ZERO rows. What is causing this???

messages.author: 48ecc1e3de37e653
messages.subject: Re: Error in part 5? "number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 3)"
parts:
I think I have discovered the error, the  idloc parameter in part 2 was =2.
 I changed it to 1 seems to be working now. Must be how the filenames are formatted...

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Error in part 5? "number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 3)"

Thanks for reporting back on progress. General conclusion is to keep arguments consistent across the 5 processing parts within a study, because GGIR relies on this when merging and combining milestone data.
Best, Vincent
